dedupe_keys.name: polnilnice za e kolesa z navedenim seznamom lokacij

description: Polnilnice za e-kolesa z navedenim seznamom lokacij is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA KAMNIK. As a project partner, the Municipality of Kamnik, together with the Development Centre of the Heart of Slovenia d.o.o., participated in the project E-Building on a Bicycle. The aim of this operation is to promote cycling as a form of sustainable mobility and also as a business opportunity. Coverage: OBČINA KAMNIK. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations for e-bikes with a list of locations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA KAMNIK. Its keywords include e-kolesa, trajnotna mobilnost, polnilnice, kolesarjenje. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
